answered.question: What does each submitted short link resolve to?
answered.answer: On 2026-11-20 each opened to a different amazon.com product page (see products.json and SRC-06 to SRC-10). Observed only through the fetch tool.

answered.question: Which disclosure wording must the site carry?
answered.answer: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' It must be clear and prominent. The site shows it under the masthead on every page and in the footer.

answered.question: Must Amazon links carry a tag?
answered.answer: Yes. Each link to an Amazon Site must include the Associates ID or tag as a URL parameter.

answered.question: Can the site show prices?
answered.answer: Only where Amazon serves the link, or through PA-API/Creators API data. The site shows no prices.

answered.question: How should paid links be marked for search engines?
answered.answer: With rel="sponsored". The site sets rel="sponsored noopener" on every outbound Amazon link.

answered.question: Where must the disclosure appear?
answered.answer: Where it is hard to miss, next to the endorsement. The site repeats it under the masthead and in the footer of every page.

answered.question: What does the Associates application check?
answered.answer: Qualified sales (at least three within 180 days), original content (rule of thumb: 10 posts), and recent website content (generally within 60 days).

unanswered.question: What product is each submitted link meant to reach?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Intended ASIN is needed for every row.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Ask the link owner, or read the item from the Associates Product Linking tool.

unanswered.question: Are the submitted short links compliant?
unanswered.why_it_matters: They are the only outbound links the owner supplied.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Test one link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow; compare destination and tracking report.

unanswered.question: Is shopnow047c-20 an enrolled Associates ID, and does the format match the account?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Every outbound link depends on it.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Log in to Associates Central and check Account Settings; check that Special Link reports record clicks.

unanswered.question: What are current prices, ratings and availability?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Buyers decide on these; they are blank here.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Decide whether PA-API/Creators API access will be pursued.

unanswered.question: Which five events should analytics record?
unanswered.why_it_matters: The request says five defined events; the list was not provided.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner confirms the list; the site stores the proposed set until then.

unanswered.question: Which hosting will serve the self-hosted analytics endpoint?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Click counting is disabled until an endpoint exists.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner chooses a host; the endpoint URL goes into site.json.

unanswered.question: Which publishing cadence should be used?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Guides are only useful if they are maintained; Associates reviews check recency.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner picks one of the options in S-02.

unanswered.question: Who is the author or publisher, and what is the brand name?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Publications show a named editorial owner.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner supplies the name and a contact address.

unanswered.question: Do air-fryer and thermometer dimensions, warranties and return windows match the official listing?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Counter-space and cleanup guides need dimensions.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Read the 'Product information' table on each listing and record it with its date; no dimension data was captured in this session.

unanswered.question: Which search queries bring readers to the site?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Topic choice should come from measured queries, not instinct.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Verify the site in Search Console and collect query data for 90 days.

unanswered.question: Will the site collect email addresses?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Email is restricted to opted-in recipients under the Associates policy.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner decides; if yes, a double opt-in form is required before any Special Link goes into email.

unanswered.question: Does the site meet the Associates content bar?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Applications are reviewed on original, recent content.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner adds original posts and checks Associates' current published rule of thumb.

unanswered.question: Does Amazon's own help article define an ASIN as 10 characters?
unanswered.why_it_matters: The ASIN length check depends on it.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Locate the Amazon help article; otherwise accept forum source SRC-11 with its limits.

unanswered.question: Which branch's site should go to main?
unanswered.why_it_matters: Another session claimed the same task on arena/2b309a82-wina.
unanswered.how_to_discover: Owner decides; integration session reconciles COORDINATION.md.
